system.description:
• The seafaring musical tradition of Opal's docks and merchant fleets — work songs, storm calls, the music that keeps a crew rowing when the wind dies. Opal's position as a maritime hub means this tradition draws from every culture that passes through its harbours.
  • Sea Shanty: Exalt's bonus applies to all allies' saves vs fear and exhaustion while aboard a ship or boat, or in any harsh environment (storms, desert marches, extended exposure) — not just at sea.
  • Maritime Voice: Advantage on Seamanship checks and on Charisma-based checks with sailors, pirates, dock workers, and maritime merchants.
